description: This file defines the InboundEmail class, which is a core component of the SuiteCRM module responsible for handling inbound email configurations, connections, and operations such as fetching, caching, and managing emails via IMAP/POP3 protocols. It includes methods for email retrieval, cache management, mailbox operations, and access controls.

classes.name: InboundEmail
classes.description: Represents an inbound email account configuration and handles email fetching, cache management, mailbox operations, and access controls within the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.description: Represents an inbound email account configuration, managing email fetching, cache management, mailbox functions, folder operations, access controls, and auto-responses within SuiteCRM.
